title: Learning Graph Viewer
description: Interactive visualization of learning graphs showing concept dependencies with search, taxonomy filtering, and statistics.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Education
Graph Visualization
Learning Graphs
Knowledge Mapping
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisite dependencies between concepts by tracing the directed edges of a learning graph
Filter the graph by taxonomy category using the legend checkboxes to isolate a single topic area
Explain why a nonzero orphan count signals concepts that lack prerequisite or dependent connections
Locate a specific concept node with the type-ahead search and interpret its group assignment
Evaluate a lesson sequence by progressively enabling foundation categories before advanced ones
